overview: Discover the Midwest region’s fascinating history, natural beauty, and unexpected treasures. From the post-World War II American dream to the North Shore’s distinctive residential enclaves, Chicago’s northern suburbs are rich with contrasts, fascinating history, and unexpected discoveries. Native American heritage, utopian religious communities, breathtaking lakefront vistas, fine dining, and notable names are all part of the story. In WTTW’s new special, Chicago’s Northern Suburbs, Emmy Award-winning Geoffrey Baer journeys through 19 communities, uncovering remarkable stories, visiting celebrated landmarks, and introducing the people and places that have shaped this distinctive region.
title: Chicago’s Northern Suburbs
